Just aim your sights at Runnin’ Wild Wild Game Seasoning. This stuff’ll knock you clean outta your camouflage. Just blanket your deer, fowl, turkey, or boar with plenty of Wild Game Seasoning. Wait it out 30 minutes; then grill away. (If you really want to get the coyotes howlin’, let it marinate overnight.) Shake on more while it’s cookin’, and you’ll buck up the flavor big time!
